name: Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker
tagline: Enterprise-Grade WordPress Affiliate Link Management & Cloaking Suite (24 Core Features)
description: An enterprise-grade, performance-optimized WordPress affiliate link management and cloaking suite. Built natively upon WordPress's standard database architecture (wp_posts and wp_postmeta), it transforms ugly, fragile affiliate links into clean, memorable, branded URLs hosted directly on your primary domain—delivering 25% to 40% higher click-through rates, dynamic visitor routing, automated FTC legal disclosures, Amazon ToS compliance uncloaking, automated broken link health monitoring, A/B traffic split testing, and direct 1-click Stripe payment checkouts.

keyFeatures.title: Branded Link Cloaking & Custom Slugs
keyFeatures.description: Transform messy affiliate links into clean URLs on your root domain (yoursite.com/go/deal) lifting CTR by 25% to 40%.

keyFeatures.title: Configurable URL Prefixes & Category Paths
keyFeatures.description: Customize global redirect folder (/go/, /recommends/, /deal/) and dynamically inject categories into permalinks.

keyFeatures.title: Multi-Status HTTP Redirect Engine (301, 302, 307, 200)
keyFeatures.description: Full control over browser caching with 307 uncached temporary redirects (gold standard) or 200 iFrame mask.

keyFeatures.title: Search Engine Crawler & Link Controls
keyFeatures.description: Auto-injects rel="nofollow", rel="sponsored", target="_blank", and X-Robots-Tag: noindex headers to protect SEO rankings.

keyFeatures.title: Smart ToS Uncloaking (Amazon & eBay)
keyFeatures.description: Renders raw direct links on frontend to protect accounts under Amazon §6 while logging background click analytics.

keyFeatures.title: FTC Auto-Disclosure Injector
keyFeatures.description: Automatically injects compliant affiliate disclaimers above or below posts with customizable badges and callouts.

keyFeatures.title: In-Dashboard Click Tracking & Visual Analytics
keyFeatures.description: Internal bot-filtered logging tracking clicks, unique visitors, referral sources, device types, and CSV export.

keyFeatures.title: Client-Side Conditional Redirect Rules
keyFeatures.description: Dynamically route visitors by Operating System (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS), Device, Browser, or Language.

keyFeatures.title: DOM-Safe Keyword Auto-Linker
keyFeatures.description: Scans post content and auto-links target keywords without corrupting HTML headings, images, or existing anchors.

keyFeatures.title: Broken Link Health Scanner & Status Monitor
keyFeatures.description: Background cron scanner verifying target merchant URLs and displaying HTTP status badges (🟢 200 OK / 🔴 404 Error).

keyFeatures.title: A/B Split Testing & Traffic Rotation
keyFeatures.description: Distribute incoming clicks across multiple target merchant URLs by weighted percentage to maximize conversions.

keyFeatures.title: Seamless Payment Links (Stripe Integration)
keyFeatures.description: Direct Stripe API checkout links for digital downloads and consultations without heavyweight WooCommerce overhead.

documentationSections.title: Phase 1: Installation & Setup
documentationSections.content: Uploading smart-affiliate-link-cloaker.zip in WordPress Admin Dashboard and configuring global rules.
steps: Upload ZIP via WP Admin -> Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin.
Activate plugin. Activator creates wp_salc_clicks table, seeds global defaults, and configures health scan cron.
Go to Link Cloaker -> Settings. Confirm Global Prefix (go), Anonymize IP (ON), Smart ToS (ON), and Default HTTP Redirect (307).
Go to Settings -> Permalinks and click Save Changes to register top-priority rewrite rules.

documentationSections.title: Phase 2: Creating Your First Branded Link
documentationSections.content: Creating clean, branded referral URLs with custom post type salc_link and metaboxes.
steps: Navigate to Link Cloaker -> Add New Link.
Enter Title (e.g. 'Web Hosting Deal') and Target Destination Affiliate URL (e.g. https://merchant.com/?aff_id=123).
Select Redirect Type (307 Temporary Recommended) and toggle rel="nofollow sponsored" and target="_blank".
Assign Categories & Tags (aff_category / aff_tag) and click Publish.

documentationSections.title: Phase 3: Advanced Conditional Routing & PRO Monetization
documentationSections.content: Configuring Conditional Routing, Stripe Checkout Links, Keyword Auto-Linker, and Expiration.
steps: Conditional Routing: Add rules based on OS (macOS -> Mac offer, Android -> Google Play, iOS -> App Store) or Device/Browser.
Stripe Payment: Enter Stripe Secret Key sk_live_... & Webhook Secret in Settings. Toggle Enable Stripe on link metabox and enter Price ID.
Keyword Auto-Linker: Go to Settings -> Auto-Linker, set max limits per post, and add keyword-to-link mapping rules.
Deal Expiration: Set UTC expiration datetime or click cap, fallback URL (302 redirect), or custom expired message.

documentationSections.title: Phase 4: Compliance, Uncloaking & Analytics
documentationSections.content: Activating FTC Legal Disclosures, Smart ToS Uncloaking, and inspecting local click statistics.
steps: Go to Link Cloaker -> Settings -> FTC Auto-Disclosure. Choose position (Before Post, After Post, Inline) and style (Callout, Badge, Bordered).
Verify Smart ToS Uncloaking: Test an Amazon URL. Raw link renders on frontend while beacon tracks clicks via navigator.sendBeacon.
Go to Link Cloaker -> Statistics to inspect real-time click charts, device breakdown, top performing links, and export CSV.
Monitor Link Cloaker -> All Links for automated broken link health badges (🟢 200 OK / 🔴 404 Error).
